user.title: Kostal Plenticore Battery Control

data.modbus_timeout: Modbus Timeout (sec, from Inverter Web UI)

user.description:
Enter connection details for your Kostal Inverter.

Choose **Normal (with KSEM)** for standalone control with the local Kostal Smart Energy Meter. Choose **HA Inverter Grid Control (2 inverter)** when this inverter should follow another inverter via Home Assistant entities. Choose **Single Inverter Grid Control** when one inverter should trim grid import/export from one external grid-power entity.

**IMPORTANT:** Remember to change Battery Management to "External via protocol (Modbus TCP)" in the battery settings on the Inverter Web UI. (This requires installer code access).

**Unit ID** should be **71** for battery management registers on Plenticore inverters.

ksem.title: KOSTAL Smart Energy Meter (KSEM) Detected
ksem.description:
A KOSTAL Smart Energy Meter (KSEM) was detected as the connected energy meter on your inverter.

You can optionally enter the KSEM's IP address to read energy import and export values directly from it via Modbus TCP.

**Leave the field empty to skip KSEM setup.** All other sensors will still work normally.

init.title: Integration Options

data.source_inv1_status_entity: Source inverter 1 status entity (optional, e.g. inverter state)

init.description: SOC values are written directly to the inverter via Modbus. In Normal (with KSEM) mode, only the local inverter settings are used here. In HA Inverter Grid Control (2 inverter) mode, configure the source entities and assist tuning values here. Mirror switch entities are optional; if left blank, this inverter uses its own local Charge/Discharge/Block switches instead. The inverter 1 status entity is also optional; the recommended source is inverter 1's Inverter State sensor from this integration. If it indicates inverter 1 is offline or inactive, inverter 2 ignores inverter 1 power and falls back to the grid point. In Single Inverter Grid Control mode, configure the external grid-power entity and the grid-trim tuning values here. Leave SOC limits blank to leave the inverter setting unchanged.
